item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog rig pa khu byug gi rgyud las 'khor ba gtan 'joms sbyin sreg 'phyong
item.coloph: brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ lha klu mi gsum gyis/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud do/ des lho yi gshen gsum/ des zhang zhung gshen gsum/ des gyer spungs dran pa/ des rje lha bsgom/ blon mu thur/ stang dmu tsa/ ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi la brgyud do/ gshen de bzhi yi rgyung srub shel brag la sgrub pa bsnyems nas/ byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la/ bka' gter gnyis su phyes nas sbas so/ dus nam zhig nas/ stong dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ bka' gter ma bu cha lag tu bsgrags nas/ phyi rabs las ldan gyi skyes bu la snyan du brgyud do//
